descriptionMarkdown:
My take on the superlative blueprint.  

basic ores belted in, vanilla items, but saved several item assemblers for Space.  easy to start this with level 2 assemblers and yellow inserters, later elevate to level 3 and blue inserters(note the plate recycling requires blue underground belts) 

uses yellow chests instead of red.  most are keyed to a specific item.  this makes tearing down your starter base and recycling items, ore, plates very easy = your item collection stays highly organized.  change the # at each pertinent inserter to customize your build quantities.  

 the left side group of yellow chests is sort of the catch everything else / personal storage, I use the jetpack mod constantly so it's a great place to hover while getting serviced by logistics bots.  also fine spot for early build trains, to the left of the massed roboports.   

if you find egregious errors please msg me
